description: Stay in this lovely apartment located in the chic Gaillon district, between Palais Garnier and the Palais Royal Garden. With 3 elegant bedrooms and a bright living room with a sofa bed, it comfortably accommodates up to 8 guests. Enjoy central air conditioning, a fully equipped kitchen, and a prime location to explore Paris in style and comfort.The spaceDiscover this elegant apartment, renovated with taste featuring:* Comfortable living room with sofa bed and dining table* Fully equipped kitchen (fridge, oven, microwave, dishwasher)* Bedroom 1: queen‑size bed with en‑suite bathroom* Bedroom 2: queen‑size bed with en‑suite bathroom* Bedroom 3: queen‑size bed * A third separated bathroom, with shower, WC and sinkGuest accessFull access to the apartment for a fully independent stayOther things to note* High-speed Wi-Fi* Stair access* Central air conditioning* Baby crib provided* Quiet building* Three bedrooms + one sofa bed (8 guests)* Bed linen, towels, and toiletries provided* Private driver / airport transfer on requestPlease contact us for any additional requests.We look forward to hosting you!
